review.description: Merged all614 stable glossary terms from current main and the development branch, retaining report/evidence/delivery vocabulary alongside plugin inventory, review policy, work status and GitHub budget meanings. Historical adoption identity is unchanged. state-deferred now includes an accepted launch delayed by GitHub request capacity.
review.implementation: Merged terms by stable ID and preserved canonical names, aliases, optional scopes and definition-only ownership. The UI and flow registries consume the combined terms without adding foundation backlinks or implementation procedures. The definition remains meaning-only, with no consuming UI/flow backlinks or runtime procedure; existing scopes and stable IDs are retained.

Existing scoped-name, duplicate-member, dependency-direction and generated-reference tooling assertions remain mapped and are rerun during reconciliation. The rendered glossary and decoded registry validation preserve same-scope uniqueness and dependency direction; deferred launch assertions supply consuming behavior evidence separately.
